summary: A clear results focus and WhatsApp follow up are strengths, but leftover editor text, a dead call to action and one testimonial appear to cost you bookings.

findings.problem: The email and phone links in the Contact section point to a Google search page, and Start your Treatment Journey links back to the homepage.
findings.cost: A patient who taps to call or email cannot, and the main button goes nowhere.
findings.fix: Tested call and email links and a real booking button.

findings.problem: Visible leftovers include 'Describe your image', 'Use tab to navigate through the menu items', 'top of page', and a 'Thank you!' message before any form is sent.
findings.cost: Editor text makes a medical brand look unfinished.
findings.fix: A clean page with no leftover text.

findings.problem: The service dropdown shows Choose an option with no options, and Appointment sends people to a separate page.
findings.cost: Enquiries are lost at the form.
findings.fix: A working form on the page.

findings.problem: One testimonial from a first name and initial is shown, with no before and after images, doctor names or credentials, and the name appears as The Aesthetics Clinic and The Aesthetic Clinic.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients decide on proof and see almost none.
findings.fix: Reviews, captioned results and named practitioners.

redesign: Working call, email and booking buttons.
A clean page and a form with treatment options.
Reviews, captioned results and named practitioners.
